newsitem.title: USA: MGM revamps TV group, names Symes president.
newsitem.headline: MGM revamps TV group, names Symes president.

text.p: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc said Tuesday it had restructured its television organization, renaming it the MGM Worldwide Television Group, and that it had named John Symes as president of the group.
It said Symes would report directly to MGM Chairman and chief executive Frank Mancuso and take on added duties for the company's international pay and free television operations.

Also, he will oversee development and production of television programming and also oversee the expansion of MGM Gold, the studio's first satellite-delivered branded Hollywood entertainment channel, the company said.
